en.text: We have released MarmoCast version 1.0.5! There are five major updates in this version.
texts: We have released MarmoCast version 1.0.5! There are five major updates in this version.
ttsTexts: We have released MarmoCast version 1.0.5! There are five major updates in this version.

en.text: First, a "file selection screen" that opens with a click can now be used for loading files. The traditional drag-and-drop method is still available.
texts: First, a "file selection screen" that opens with a click can now be used for loading files. The traditional drag-and-drop method is still available.
ttsTexts: First, a "file selection screen" that opens with a click can now be used for loading files. The traditional drag-and-drop method is still available.

en.text: You can use this when importing image or video files to the BEAT tab.
texts: You can use this when importing image or video files to the BEAT tab.
ttsTexts: You can use this when importing image or video files to the BEAT tab.

en.text: It can also be used when loading image files in the material tab.
texts: It can also be used when loading image files in the material tab.
ttsTexts: It can also be used when loading image files in the material tab.

en.text: Second point. Images and videos generated within a project can now be reused in other beats. You can select materials that have already been generated within the project from the file selection screen.
texts: Second point. Images and videos generated within a project can now be reused in other beats. You can select materials that have already been generated within the project from the file selection screen.
ttsTexts: Second point. Images and videos generated within a project can now be reused in other beats. You can select materials that have already been generated within the project from the file selection screen.

en.text: This can also be used when loading image or video files in the BEAT tab.
texts: This can also be used when loading image or video files in the BEAT tab.
ttsTexts: This can also be used when loading image or video files in the BEAT tab.

en.text: You can also use it when loading image files in the materials tab.
texts: You can also use it when loading image files in the materials tab.
ttsTexts: You can also use it when loading image files in the materials tab.

en.text: Third, in the advanced mode "image generation prompt," you can now specify the time for each beat.
texts: Third, in the advanced mode "image generation prompt," you can now specify the time for each beat.
ttsTexts: Third, in the advanced mode "image generation prompt," you can now specify the time for each beat.

en.text: The time that can be set differs depending on whether video generation is enabled.
texts: The time that can be set differs depending on whether video generation is enabled.
ttsTexts: The time that can be set differs depending on whether video generation is enabled.

en.text: Fourth: The name of the "Character" tab has been changed to the "Materials" tab.
texts: Fourth: The name of the "Character" tab has been changed to the "Materials" tab.
ttsTexts: Fourth: The name of the "Character" tab has been changed to the "Materials" tab.

en.text: Fifth, added preset templates to Mermaid.
